note: Versioned WorkLease store — same append-per-update pattern as items.jsonl; folded by lease_id. Active leases are always the latest record per id, so folding never drops a live lease. MSN-STORE-BOUNDS-2: also compacted by the writer at write time inside the coordination mutation fence (WORK_LEASES_COMPACT_MIN_BYTES 1 MiB), and self_managed: the janitor no longer folds it outside the coordination fence (a janitor park could hide an active lease from a concurrent claim). Readers stream and read the parked copy during a compaction; the archive goes to work-coordination/compaction-archive/.
